title: 2024, Bluffdale City Planning Commission Meeting Agenda 03-06-2024

votes.motion: Commissioner Kraupp moved to APPROVE the minutes of February 7, 2024, with the edits noted. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Flynn

Commissioner Flynn moved to forward a POSITIVE RECOMMENDATION to the City Council for the Zoning Map Amendment (2024-06) based on the following findings: 1. The proposed use is permitted in the GC-1 zone and is similar in intensity to others in the GC-1 zone. 2. The proposed use facilitates economic development and opportunity in the community. 3. The Planning Commission can make other applicable findings. Commissioner Griffis seconded the motion

Commissioner Flynn moved to forward a POSITIVE recommendation to the City Council for the Text Amendment Application 2024-10, based on the following findings: 1. The proposed text amendment supports the goals of the General Plan to provide flexibility for economic development. 2. The proposed text amendment is consistent with building height standards in other commercial zones in this area. 3. The Planning Commission can make other applicable findings. 6 BLUFFDALE CITY PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES Wednesday, March 6, 2024 Commissioner Griffis seconded the motion

Commissioner Flynn moved to forward a POSITIVE RECOMMENDATION to the City Council for the Zoning Map Amendment (2024-06) based on the following findings: 1. The proposed text amendment supports the goals of the General Plan to provide flexibility for economic development. 2.
